words.en: If something is clean, it is free from dirt, marks, or unwanted substances.

words.tr:
adj. 清楚的；明确的；清晰的；清澈的；晴朗的；
v. 清空；清除；放晴；使明确；
adv. 清楚地；彻底地；
words.ex: The instructions are clear.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明很清楚。
words.en: Free from anything that marks or darkens; transparent; bright; not obscure or ambiguous; easily understood; free from guilt or blame.

words.ex: The clerk at the store helped me find the book.
words.ex_cn: 商店里的职员帮我找到了那本书。
words.en: A clerk is a person whose job is to keep records or accounts in an office, shop, or bank.

words.ex: The clever boy solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这个聪明的男孩很快解决了这道数学题。
words.en: Someone who is clever is intelligent and able to understand things easily or plan things well.

words.ex: The hiker stood at the edge of the cliff.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者站在悬崖边上。
words.en: A cliff is a high area of rock with a very steep side, often at the edge of the sea or a river.

words.ex: The climate in summer is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 夏天的气候非常炎热。
words.en: The climate of a place is the general weather conditions that are typical of it.

words.ex: The boy will climb the tree to get the ball.
words.ex_cn: 男孩会爬树去拿球。
words.en: To climb means to go up something, such as a mountain or a ladder, usually with some effort.

words.ex: He went to the clinic for a check-up.
words.ex_cn: 他去诊所做检查。
words.en: A clinic is a place where people receive medical treatment or advice, especially for a particular illness or condition.

words.ex: He looks at the clock every hour.
words.ex_cn: 他每小时看一次钟。
words.en: A clock is an instrument that shows the time, usually in hours and minutes.

words.ex: The scientist created a clone of the sheep.
words.ex_cn: 科学家克隆了一只羊。
words.en: A clone is an organism or cell produced asexually from one ancestor or stock, to which they are genetically identical.

words.tr:
adj. 接近的；亲密的；
adv. 紧挨地；接近地；
v. 关闭；
words.ex: They are close friends.
words.ex_cn: 他们是亲密的朋友。
words.en: To move so as to bar passage through something; to shut.

words.ex: She bought some cloth to make a dress.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一些布来做裙子。
words.en: Cloth is fabric which is made by weaving or knitting cotton, wool, silk, or other threads. Cloth is used especially for making clothes.

words.ex: He hangs his clothes on the line to dry.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服挂在绳子上晾干。
words.en: Clothes are the things that people wear, such as shirts, coats, trousers, and dresses.

words.ex: The cloud floats high in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 云朵在天空中飘浮。
words.en: A cloud is a visible mass of condensed water vapor floating in the atmosphere, typically high above the ground.

words.ex: He joins a chess club after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后加入了一个国际象棋俱乐部。
words.en: A club is an organization of people with a common purpose or interest, who meet regularly and take part in shared activities. It can also refer to a heavy stick used as a weapon or for hitting a ball in sports.

words.ex: The police found a clue at the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察在犯罪现场找到了一条线索。
words.en: A clue is an object or piece of information that helps to solve a problem or mystery.

words.tr:
n. 群；团；簇；
v. 聚集；
words.ex: The stars form a bright cluster in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 星星在夜空中形成了一群明亮的星群。
words.en: A cluster of things or people is a small group of them close together.

words.tr:
v. 抓住；攫住
n. 紧抓；离合器；一窝雏；一小群；紧要关头
words.ex: He clutched the rope tightly when he slipped.
words.ex_cn: 当他滑倒时，他紧紧抓住了绳子。
words.en: To clutch something means to hold it tightly, usually because you are afraid or anxious. In a vehicle, the clutch is a pedal that you press with your foot to change gears.

words.tr:
n. 教练；长途客运汽车；
v. 训练；培训；
words.ex: The coach taught the team how to win.
words.ex_cn: 教练教球队如何获胜。
words.en: A coach is someone who trains a person or team in a particular sport. It also refers to a large, comfortable bus that carries passengers on long journeys.

words.ex: He burns coal to keep his house warm.
words.ex_cn: 他烧煤来让房子暖和。
words.en: Coal is a hard black substance that is extracted from the ground and burned as fuel.

words.ex: We walked along the coast and saw the sea.
words.ex_cn: 我们沿着海岸散步，看到了大海。
words.en: The coast is the land along the edge of the sea or ocean.

words.ex: She added cocoa to the cake batter.
words.ex_cn: 她把可可粉加到了蛋糕糊里。
words.en: Cocoa is a brown powder made from cocoa beans, used in making chocolate and in cooking.

words.ex: He drinks coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝咖啡。
words.en: Coffee is a hot drink made from the roasted and ground seeds of a tropical shrub.

words.ex: She picked up the coil of rope from the ground.
words.ex_cn: 她从地上捡起了那卷绳子。
words.en: A coil is a length of something wound in a joined sequence of loops, or the act of winding something into loops.

words.tr:
n. 硬币；金属钱币；
v. 创造；
words.ex: He has a coin in his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他口袋里有一枚硬币。
words.en: A coin is a small, flat, round piece of metal or plastic that is used as money.

words.tr:
adj. 寒冷的；冰冷的；
n. 寒冷；
words.ex: The cold wind made me shiver.
words.ex_cn: 寒冷的风让我发抖。
words.en: Something that is cold has a low temperature, especially when compared to the temperature of the human body. It can also describe a lack of warmth in someone's behavior or a situation.

words.ex: He fixed his collar before the interview.
words.ex_cn: 他在面试前整理了衣领。
words.en: The part of a piece of clothing that fits around the neck and is usually folded over; a band of material around the neck of an animal.

words.ex: My colleague helped me with the report.
words.ex_cn: 我的同事帮我完成了报告。
words.en: A colleague is someone you work with, especially in a professional job.

words.ex: He collects stamps every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周收集邮票。
words.en: If you collect a number of things, you gather them together, usually because you want them for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He works at a small college.
words.ex_cn: 他在一所小型学院工作。
words.en: A college is an institution where students study after they have left school, in order to get a degree or qualification.

words.ex: The car crash was a serious collision.
words.ex_cn: 那场车祸是一次严重的碰撞。
words.en: A collision occurs when two or more objects come into contact with each other, often resulting in damage or a change in direction.

words.ex: The color of the sky is blue.
words.ex_cn: 天空的颜色是蓝色的。
words.en: Color is the appearance that things have that results from the way in which they reflect light.

words.ex: The ancient temple has a tall stone column.
words.ex_cn: 这座古庙有一根高大的石柱。
words.en: A column is a tall solid upright stone post used to support a building or as a monument.

words.tr:
n. 梳子
v. 梳理；搜寻
words.ex: He uses a comb to tidy his hair.
words.ex_cn: 他用梳子整理头发。
words.en: A comb is a flat piece of plastic or metal with narrow pointed teeth along one side, which you use to make your hair neat.

words.ex: She combines flour and water to make dough.
words.ex_cn: 她把面粉和水混合在一起做面团。
words.en: To combine means to join or merge two or more things together to form a single entity.

words.ex: Please come to my house tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 请明天来我家。
words.en: To move or travel towards the speaker or with the speaker; to arrive at a place; to happen or take place.

words.ex: He likes to watch comedy on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在电视上看喜剧。
words.en: A comedy is a type of drama or other art form the main object of which, according to modern notions, is to amuse.

words.ex: The soft chair gives me comfort.
words.ex_cn: 这把软椅子给我带来舒服。
words.en: If you comfort someone, you make them feel less worried, unhappy, or upset, for example by saying kind things to them.

words.tr:
n. 连环漫画；
adj. 滑稽的；
words.ex: He reads a comic every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上读一本连环漫画。
words.en: A comic is someone who entertains people by making them laugh, especially a professional comedian.

words.tr:
n. 指挥；命令；
v. 掌握；
words.ex: The general has command of the army.
words.ex_cn: 将军指挥着军队。
words.en: If someone in authority commands you to do something, they tell you that you must do it.

words.tr:
v. 评论；表达意见；
n. 评论；意见；
words.ex: He commented on the movie last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚对这部电影发表了评论。
words.en: A comment is something that you say which expresses your opinion of something or which gives an explanation of it.

words.ex: Small commerce helps local towns grow.
words.ex_cn: 小商业有助于小镇的发展。
words.en: Commerce is the activity of buying and selling things, especially on a large scale.

words.tr:
adj. 贸易的；商业的；
n. 广告；
words.ex: The commercial ship sailed to another country.
words.ex_cn: 这艘贸易船只驶向了另一个国家。
words.en: Commercial relates to the business of buying and selling goods and services.

words.tr:
n. 委员会；佣金；
v. 委托；
words.ex: The commission met to discuss the new law.
words.ex_cn: 委员会开会讨论新法律。
words.en: A commission is a group of people who have been appointed to find out about something or to control something, or the act of doing this. It can also refer to a sum of money that is paid to someone for selling something, which is usually a percentage of the value of the goods sold.

words.tr: v. 承诺；犯（罪、错）；（公开地）表达意见；
words.ex: He commit to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺帮助他的朋友。
words.en: To commit means to carry out or perpetrate a mistake, crime, or immoral act; or to pledge or bind oneself to a certain course of action.

words.ex: The committee meets every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 委员会每周一开会。
words.en: A committee is a group of people who are chosen to do a particular job or make decisions on behalf of a larger group.

words.tr: adj. 常见的；普通的；共有的；
words.ex: Colds are a common illness in winter.
words.ex_cn: 感冒在冬天是很常见的疾病。
words.en: Something that is common happens often or is found in many places.

words.ex: They communicate well with each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们彼此沟通得很好。
words.en: To communicate means to share or exchange information, news, or ideas, especially by speaking or writing.

words.ex: The community cleaned the park together.
words.ex_cn: 社区居民一起清理了公园。
words.en: A community is a group of people who live in the same area or who have the same interests, religion, or nationality.

words.ex: He works for a small company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小公司工作。
words.en: A company is a business organization that makes money by producing or selling goods or services.

words.ex: He compare apples and oranges to see which is sweeter.
words.ex_cn: 他比较苹果和橙子，看看哪个更甜。
words.en: If you compare one thing with another, you consider the similarities and differences between them.

words.ex: He used a compass to find north.
words.ex_cn: 他用指南针找北方。
words.en: A compass is an instrument that you use for finding directions. It has a dial and a magnetic needle that always points to the north.

words.ex: Two companies compete for the same customers.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司为争夺相同的客户而竞争。
words.en: If you compete with someone for something, you try to get it for yourself and stop the other person getting it. You can also say that two people compete for something that they both want.

words.ex: There is strong competition between the two companies.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司之间竞争激烈。
words.en: Competition is a situation in which two or more people or groups are trying to get something which not everyone can have.

words.ex: He complains about the loud noise every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都抱怨噪音太大。
words.en: To express dissatisfaction, pain, or resentment, usually because of a particular situation or someone's actions.

words.tr:
adj. 完整的；完成的；
v. 完成；
words.ex: The book is complete with all chapters.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有所有章节，是完整的。
words.en: If you complete something, you finish doing, making, or producing it.

words.tr:
adj. 复杂的；
n. 综合楼（群）；
words.ex: The instructions are too complex for children.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明对孩子来说太复杂了。
words.en: Something that is complex has many different parts, and is therefore often difficult to understand.

words.ex: The math problem is complicated.
words.ex_cn: 这个数学问题很复杂。
words.en: Involving many different and confusing aspects.

words.ex: He composes music in his spare time.
words.ex_cn: 他在空闲时间创作音乐。
words.en: To compose something means to make it by combining parts or elements.

words.tr: n. 构成；作曲；（学生）作文；创作技巧；
words.ex: The composition of the rock includes sand and clay.
words.ex_cn: 这种岩石的构成包括沙子和黏土。
words.en: The way in which something is composed or arranged; the act of creating something, especially a piece of writing or music.

words.ex: He cannot comprehend the simple math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他无法理解这个简单的数学问题。
words.en: To comprehend something means to understand it fully.

words.ex: He compresses the file to save space.
words.ex_cn: 他压缩文件以节省空间。
words.en: To compress something means to press it or squeeze it so that it takes up less space.

words.tr:
n. 妥协；
v. 危及；
words.ex: They reached a compromise after hours of talk.
words.ex_cn: 经过数小时的讨论，他们达成了妥协。
words.en: A compromise is an agreement between two people or groups in which each side gives up some of the things they want so that both sides are happy at the end.

words.ex: He computes the total cost quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快算出总成本。
words.en: If you compute a total, amount, or result, you calculate it.

words.ex: He tried to conceal the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他试图隐藏真相。
words.en: If you conceal something, you prevent it from being seen or known about.

words.ex: You must concentrate on your homework.
words.ex_cn: 你必须集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you concentrate on something, you give it your full attention and think about it carefully.

words.ex: The concept of freedom is important in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 自由这个观念在许多国家都很重要。
words.en: A concept is an idea or abstract principle.

words.tr:
n. 担忧；关注；
v. 涉及；
words.ex: His main concern is his child's safety.
words.ex_cn: 他主要的担忧是孩子的安全。
words.en: If something concerns you, it worries you or causes you to feel anxious.

words.tr: n. 音乐会；演奏会；一致；和谐；
words.ex: We went to a concert last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚去听了音乐会。
words.en: A concert is a performance of music by one or more musicians or singers, which usually takes place in the evening.

words.ex: He concluded that the experiment failed.
words.ex_cn: 他得出结论说实验失败了。
words.en: If you conclude that something is true, you decide that it is true using the facts you know as a basis.

words.tr:
n. 混凝土；
adj. 具体的；
words.ex: The workers poured concrete to build the foundation.
words.ex_cn: 工人们浇筑混凝土来建造地基。
words.en: Concrete is a hard, strong construction material made by mixing a cementing material (such as Portland cement) and a mineral aggregate (such as sand and gravel) with sufficient water to cause the cement to set and bind the entire mass. In a broader sense, concrete can also refer to something that is tangible, specific, or real.

words.ex: His condition improved after the treatment.
words.ex_cn: 他的状况在接受治疗后好转了。
words.en: A condition is a state of affairs that must exist or be brought about before something else can happen or be done.

words.tr:
v. 实施；传导（电、热）；
n. 行为；举止；
words.ex: The company will conduct a survey next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司将在下周进行一项调查。
words.en: To organize and carry out a particular activity.

words.ex: The global climate conference was held in Paris.
words.ex_cn: 全球气候大会在巴黎举行。
words.en: A conference is a meeting of people who share the same interests or profession.

words.ex: He spoke with confidence during the presentation.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲时充满信心。
words.en: Confidence is a feeling of self-assurance arising from one's appreciation of one's own abilities or qualities.

words.ex: The test results confirm he has the disease.
words.ex_cn: 检测结果证实他患有这种疾病。
words.en: To confirm something means to establish its truth or validity by providing evidence or proof.

words.ex: The conflict between the two countries lasted for years.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家之间的冲突持续了多年。
words.en: A conflict is a serious disagreement or argument, typically a protracted one.

words.ex: The instructions confuse me.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明让我感到困惑。
words.en: If you confuse two things, you mix them up in your mind so that you think one is the other.

words.tr: n. 代表大会；议会；国会；
words.ex: The congress met to discuss new laws.
words.ex_cn: 代表大会召开以讨论新法律。
words.en: A congress is a formal meeting of representatives, as of various nations, to discuss problems or to make decisions.

words.ex: The bridge connects the two cities.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥连接了两座城市。
words.en: If something or someone connects one thing to another, or if one thing connects to another, the two things are joined together.

words.ex: He listened to his conscience and told the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他听从了良心，说出了真相。
words.en: Your conscience is the part of your mind that tells you whether what you are doing is right or wrong.

words.ex: He was conscious after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故后他醒了过来。
words.en: If you are conscious of something, you notice it or are aware of it.

words.ex: He asked for her consent before starting the project.
words.ex_cn: 他在开始这个项目之前征求了她的同意。
words.en: Consent is permission for something to happen or agreement to do something.

words.ex: Lying has serious consequences.
words.ex_cn: 撒谎会有严重的后果。
words.en: A consequence is a result or effect of an action or condition.

words.tr: n. 保护；节约（自然资源）；
words.ex: The park is for the conservation of wild animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园是为了保护野生动物。
words.en: The protection and preservation of the natural environment and wildlife.

words.ex: I consider going to the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我考虑明天去公园。
words.en: If you consider something, you think about it carefully.

words.ex: The team consists of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名球员组成。
words.en: If something consists of particular things or people, it is made up of them.

words.tr: adj. 恒定的；不变的；持续的；
words.ex: The temperature is constant in this room.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的温度是恒定的。
words.en: Something that is constant happens all the time or is always there.

words.ex: The constitution protects the rights of all citizens.
words.ex_cn: 宪法保护所有公民的权利。
words.en: The constitution of a country or organization is the system of laws which formally states people's rights and duties.

words.tr:
v. 建造；构造；
n. 概念；
words.ex: They construct houses with bricks.
words.ex_cn: 他们用砖块建造房屋。
words.en: To construct something means to build or create it, usually something large such as a building, road, or machine.

words.ex: He will consult a doctor for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他将咨询医生治疗他的头痛。
words.en: to seek information or advice from someone, especially someone who is an expert in a particular field

words.ex: The car consumes a lot of gas.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车消耗很多汽油。
words.en: To consume something means to eat or drink it, or to use it up in some way.

words.tr:
n. 接触；联系；
v. 接触；联系；
words.ex: The two balls made contact when they collided.
words.ex_cn: 两个球在碰撞时发生了接触。
words.en: Contact refers to the act of communicating with someone, especially regularly, or the state of touching something.

words.ex: The box contains five apples.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子包含五个苹果。
words.en: If something such as a box, bag, room, or place contains things, those things are inside it.

words.tr: adj. 现代的；当代的；同时代的；
words.ex: This museum displays contemporary art.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆展示现代艺术。
words.en: Belonging to or occurring in the present; or a person or thing living or existing at the same time as another.

words.tr:
n. 内容；含量；
adj. 满足的；
words.ex: The content of the video is very interesting.
words.ex_cn: 这个视频的内容非常有趣。
words.en: Content refers to the things that are held or included in something, or the state of being happy and satisfied.

words.ex: He won the spelling contest.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得了拼写比赛。
words.en: A contest is a competition or a struggle for victory between individuals or groups.

words.ex: The word means different things in different context.
words.ex_cn: 这个词在不同的上下文中意思不同。
words.en: The context of an idea or event is the general situation that relates to it, and which helps it to be understood.

words.ex: Asia is the largest continent.
words.ex_cn: 亚洲是最大的洲。
words.en: A continent is a very large area of land, such as Africa or Asia, that consists of several countries.

words.ex: He will continue walking after the break.
words.ex_cn: 休息后他会继续走路。
words.en: If someone or something continues to do something, they keep doing it and do not stop.

words.ex: The rain was continuous all day.
words.ex_cn: 雨一整天都在下个不停。
words.en: Something that is continuous happens or exists without stopping or being interrupted.

words.tr:
n. 合同；契约；
v. 收缩；
words.ex: They signed a contract to buy the house.
words.ex_cn: 他们签署了一份购买房子的合同。
words.en: A contract is a legal agreement between two or more parties. It can also mean to become smaller or tighter, or to catch a disease.

words.tr:
n. 对照；反差；对立；
v. 对比；和...形成对照；
words.ex: The contrast between light and dark is clear in the photo.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片中明暗的对照很明显。
words.en: A contrast is a great difference between two or more things which is clear when you compare them.

words.tr: v. 贡献；促成；捐献；投稿；
words.ex: He contributes money to the charity.
words.ex_cn: 他向慈善机构捐款。
words.en: If you contribute to something, you help to cause it or make it happen.

words.tr:
n. 控制；管制；
v. 控制；操纵；
words.ex: The teacher has good control of the class.
words.ex_cn: 老师对课堂有很好的控制。
words.en: To control something means to have power over it and to be able to make it do what you want.

words.ex: The store is open 24 hours for your convenience.
words.ex_cn: 商店24小时营业，以方便您。
words.en: The state of being able to proceed with something with little effort or difficulty.

words.ex: It is a convention to shake hands when you meet someone.
words.ex_cn: 见面时握手是一种习俗。
words.en: A convention is a large meeting of an organization or political group, or a way of behaving that is considered to be correct or polite by most people in a society.

words.ex: We had a short conversation about the weather.
words.ex_cn: 我们简短地聊了聊天气。
words.en: A conversation is a talk between two or more people, in which news and ideas are exchanged.

words.tr:
v. 烹饪；
n. 厨师；
words.ex: My mom cooks dinner every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈每天晚上做饭。
words.en: To prepare food for eating by using heat.

words.ex: She ate a cookie after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 她在午饭后吃了一块饼干。
words.en: A cookie is a small sweet cake, typically round and flat, that is baked and often served as a snack.

words.tr:
adj. 凉爽的；酷的；凉的；顶好的；
v. 变凉；
words.ex: The water is cool after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后水很凉爽。
words.en: If you say that a person or their behavior is cool, you mean that they are calm and unemotional, especially in a difficult situation.

words.ex: They cooperate to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他们合作以按时完成项目。
words.en: If you cooperate with someone, you work with them or help them for a particular purpose.

words.ex: She coordinates the team's schedule.
words.ex_cn: 她协调团队的安排。
words.en: If you coordinate an activity, you organize the various people and things involved in it. If you coordinate the different parts of your body, you make them work together efficiently.

words.tr:
n. 副本；(书，报纸等的) 一本；复制品；
v. 复制；
words.ex: Please give me a copy of the report.
words.ex_cn: 请给我一份报告的副本。
words.en: A copy is a thing made to be similar or identical to another. As a verb, to copy means to make a similar or identical version of something.

words.tr:
n. 核；核心；重点；
adj. 核心的；
words.ex: The core of the apple is not edible.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的核心不能吃。
words.en: The central or most important part of something.

words.ex: He ate popcorn made from corn.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了用玉米做的爆米花。
words.en: Corn is a tall plant which produces long vegetables covered with yellow seeds. It is also a cereal crop.

words.ex: The café is on the corner of Main Street and Oak Avenue.
words.ex_cn: 这家咖啡馆在主街和橡树大道的拐角处。
words.en: A corner is a point or an area where two or more edges, sides, or surfaces of something meet. It can also refer to a difficult situation or to the act of gaining control of a market.

words.ex: The corporation sells smartphones worldwide.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司向全球销售智能手机。
words.en: A corporation is a large company or group of companies that is controlled together as a single organization.

words.tr:
adj. 正确的；
v. 改正；修正；
words.ex: The answer is correct.
words.ex_cn: 这个答案是正确的。
words.en: If something is correct, it is right and true. If you correct someone, you tell them that they are wrong.

words.ex: The number of apples corresponds to the number of oranges.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的数量与橙子的数量相对应。
words.en: If one thing corresponds to another, there is a close similarity or connection between them, often because one is the cause or the result of the other.

words.ex: The boy walked down the long corridor.
words.ex_cn: 男孩走过了长长的走廊。
words.en: A corridor is a long passage in a building, with doors and rooms on one or both sides.

words.tr:
n. 费用；代价；
v. 花费；
words.ex: The cost of the book is ten dollars.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的费用是十美元。
words.en: The amount of money that you need in order to buy, make, or do something.

words.ex: They live in a small cottage near the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在森林附近的一座小村舍里。
words.en: A cottage is a small house, usually in the countryside.

words.ex: She wore a dress made of cotton.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件棉质裙子。
words.en: Cotton is a plant that produces a soft fiber which is used to make cloth or thread. Cotton is also the cloth or thread that is made from this fiber.

words.tr:
n. 咳嗽；
v. 咳嗽；
words.ex: He had a bad cough last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚咳得很厉害。
words.en: A cough is a sudden, forceful expulsion of air from the lungs, often caused by irritation in the airway.

words.tr: n. 理事会；委员会；议会；
words.ex: The city council made a new rule about recycling.
words.ex_cn: 市政府理事会制定了关于回收的新规定。
words.en: A council is a group of people who are elected to govern a local area such as a city or, in Britain, a county.

words.tr:
v. 计算；看作；清点；
n. 计数；计算；
words.ex: He counts the apples on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他计算桌子上的苹果数量。
words.en: To determine the total number of a collection of items.

words.tr:
n. 柜台；
v. 抵消；反驳；
adv. 相反地；
words.ex: The customer paid at the counter.
words.ex_cn: 顾客在柜台付款。
words.en: A counter is a long flat surface in a shop or bank on which customers are served. It can also refer to a device that counts something, or an action taken to oppose something.

words.ex: He loves his country and wants to serve it.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱自己的国家，想要为它服务。
words.en: A country is a region identified as a distinct entity in political geography.

words.ex: He grew up in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 他是在农村长大的。
words.en: The countryside refers to the land and scenery of a rural area, often characterized by farms, fields, and small villages, away from urban centers.

words.ex: He lives in a small county in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 他住在乡村的一个小郡里。
words.en: A county is a region of a country used for administrative or other purposes in certain modern nations.

words.ex: I saw a couple of birds flying in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 我看见几只鸟在天上飞。
words.en: A couple is two people who are married, living together, or having a sexual relationship. It can also refer to a small number of things or people.

words.ex: He showed courage when he saved the child from the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他从火中救出孩子时展现了勇气。
words.en: The ability to do something that frightens one; bravery.

words.ex: The course of the river changed after the flood.
words.ex_cn: 河流的流程在洪水后发生了变化。
words.en: A course is a series of lessons or lectures on a particular subject.

words.ex: The case will be heard in court next week.
words.ex_cn: 这个案件将于下周在法院审理。
words.en: A court is a place where legal matters are decided by a judge and jury or by a magistrate.

words.tr: n. 表兄弟（或姐妹）；堂兄弟（或姐妹）；
words.ex: My cousin plays soccer with me every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我的表兄弟每周六都和我一起踢足球。
words.en: A cousin is a child of your uncle or aunt.

words.tr:
v. 包括；遮盖；报道；
n. 遮盖物；庇护所；封面；
words.ex: The book covers basic math and science.
words.ex_cn: 这本书包括基础数学和科学。
words.en: If something covers something else, it has been placed over or upon it, usually in order to protect it or hide it.

words.ex: The farmer milks the cow every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农夫每天早上给母牛挤奶。
words.en: A cow is a large female animal that is kept on farms for its milk.

words.tr:
n. 懦夫；胆小鬼；胆怯者
adj. 胆小的；怯懦的
words.ex: He was a coward and ran away from the fight.
words.ex_cn: 他是个懦夫，逃跑了。
words.en: A coward is someone who is easily frightened and avoids dangerous or difficult situations.

words.tr:
n. 裂缝；噼啪声；
v. 破裂；
words.ex: There is a small crack in the wall.
words.ex_cn: 墙上有一条小裂缝。
words.en: If something hard cracks, or if you crack it, it becomes slightly damaged, with lines appearing on its surface.

words.tr: n. 工艺；手艺；行业；航空器；
words.ex: The craft of pottery takes years to learn.
words.ex_cn: 陶艺工艺需要多年才能掌握。
words.en: Skill in making things by hand; the skilled practice of a practical occupation; the skilled production of decorative or functional objects.

words.ex: The crane lifted the heavy steel beam.
words.ex_cn: 起重机吊起了沉重的钢梁。
words.en: A crane is a large machine that moves heavy things by lifting them in the air. It is also a large bird with long legs and a long neck.

words.tr:
n. 碰撞；坠毁；崩溃；
v. 碰撞；坠毁；崩溃；
words.ex: The car crash happened at the intersection.
words.ex_cn: 汽车碰撞发生在十字路口。
words.en: If a vehicle crashes or if the driver crashes it, it hits something and is damaged or destroyed.

words.ex: He wore a crazy hat to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶疯狂的帽子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as crazy, you mean that they are very enthusiastic or excited about something.

words.ex: She put cream on her coffee.
words.ex_cn: 她在咖啡里加了奶油。
words.en: Cream is the thick white or pale yellow fatty liquid which rises to the top when you boil milk, and which you can use in cooking or as a cosmetic.

words.ex: He creates beautiful paintings with colors.
words.ex_cn: 他用色彩创造美丽的画作。
words.en: To create means to bring something into existence or to cause something to happen as a result of one's actions.

words.ex: The creature lived in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这个生物生活在森林里。
words.en: A creature is a living thing, especially an animal.

words.tr:
n. 信用；赊账；赞扬；贷款；荣誉；
v. 相信；
words.ex: He has good credit with the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他在银行有良好的信用。
words.en: If you are allowed credit, you are allowed to pay for goods or services several weeks or months after you have received them.

words.tr: n. 全体船员；全体人员；
words.ex: The crew fixed the ship's engine during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 全体船员在风暴中修好了船的引擎。
words.en: A crew is a group of people who work on and operate a ship, aircraft, or train.

words.ex: He plays cricket every weekend with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都和朋友们打板球。
words.en: Cricket is a sport played between two teams of eleven players each, using a bat and ball, on a field with a wicket at each end.

words.tr:
n. 哭泣；喊叫；
v. 哭；哭泣；
words.ex: His cry woke up the whole house.
words.ex_cn: 他的哭泣惊醒了整个房子。
words.en: To shed tears, especially as an expression of distress or pain; to shout or scream, typically to express fear, pain, or grief.

words.ex: She wears a necklace made of crystal.
words.ex_cn: 她戴一条水晶制成的项链。
words.en: A crystal is a solid that has a regular, repeating arrangement of atoms. Crystals are often transparent and can be used in jewelry or as decorative objects.

words.ex: The child played with a wooden cube.
words.ex_cn: 孩子玩了一个木制立方体。
words.en: A cube is a solid object with six square faces which are all the same size.

words.ex: The teacher gave a cue to start the game.
words.ex_cn: 老师给出了开始游戏的提示。
words.en: A cue is a signal for someone to do something, or a piece of information that helps someone to understand something.

words.ex: He drank water from a cup.
words.ex_cn: 他从杯子里喝水。
words.en: A cup is a small round container that you drink from. Cups usually have handles and are made from china or plastic.

words.ex: She put the plates in the cupboard.
words.ex_cn: 她把盘子放在碗橱里。
words.en: A cupboard is a piece of furniture with doors and shelves that is used for storing things, usually in a kitchen.

words.tr:
n. 治疗；疗法；
v. 治愈；治疗；
words.ex: The new medicine is a cure for the disease.
words.ex_cn: 这种新药是这种疾病的治疗方法。
words.en: If doctors or medical treatments cure an illness or injury, they cause it to end or disappear. If a person or animal is cured of an illness or injury, they become well again.

words.ex: The child is curious about the stars.
words.ex_cn: 孩子对星星感到好奇。
words.en: If you are curious about something, you are interested in it and want to know more about it.

words.tr:
adj. 当前的；流通的；
n. （水、气、电）流；趋势；
words.ex: The current weather is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 当前的天气非常热。
words.en: belonging to the present time; happening or being used or done now

words.ex: She pulled the curtain to block the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 她拉上帷幕以挡住阳光。
words.en: A curtain is a piece of material that hangs down, often used to cover a window or to divide a room.

words.tr:
n. 弯曲；曲线；
v. （使）弯成弧形；
words.ex: The road has a sharp curve ahead.
words.ex_cn: 前面的路有一个急转弯。
words.en: A curve is a smooth, gradually bending line, for example part of the edge of a circle.

words.ex: She put a cushion on the chair to make it comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 她在椅子上放了一个靠垫，让它更舒服。
words.en: A cushion is a soft bag of some ornamental material, stuffed with wool, hair, feathers, polyester staple fiber, non-woven material, or even paper torn into fragments. It may be used for sitting or kneeling upon, or to soften the hardness or angularity of a chair or couch.

words.ex: In this village, it is a custom to light lanterns during the festival.
words.ex_cn: 在这个村庄，节日期间点灯笼是一种习俗。
words.en: A custom is an activity, a way of behaving, or an event which is usual or traditional in a particular society or in particular circumstances.

words.ex: The customer bought a new phone.
words.ex_cn: 这位客户买了一部新手机。
words.en: A customer is someone who buys goods or services from a shop or business.

words.tr:
v. 切；割；削减；
n. 切；割；削减；
words.ex: He cut the apple with a knife.
words.ex_cn: 他用刀切了苹果。
words.en: To make an opening, incision, or wound in (something) with a sharp-edged tool or object.

words.tr:
n. 循环；周期；自行车；
v. 骑自行车；循环；
words.ex: The water cycle is important for nature.
words.ex_cn: 水循环对自然界很重要。
words.en: A cycle is a series of events that are regularly repeated in the same order or a bicycle.

words.ex: My dad cooks breakfast every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我爸爸每天早上做早餐。
words.en: A father; a male parent.

words.tr:
adj. 每天的；每日的；
adv. 每天；每日；
n. 日报；
words.ex: He drinks water daily.
words.ex_cn: 他每天喝水。
words.en: Something that happens or is done daily happens or is done every day.

words.tr:
adj. 牛奶的；乳品的；
n. 乳品店；
words.ex: She bought dairy products from the local farm.
words.ex_cn: 她从当地农场买了乳制品。
words.en: A dairy is a place where milk and cream are kept or where butter and cheese are made.

words.ex: The dam holds back the river water.
words.ex_cn: 水坝拦住了河水。
words.en: A dam is a barrier that stops or restricts the flow of water or underground streams. Reservoirs created by dams not only suppress floods but also provide water for activities such as irrigation, human consumption, industrial use, aquaculture, and navigability.

words.tr:
n. 损害；破损；
v. 损害；破坏；
words.ex: The storm caused serious damage to the house.
words.ex_cn: 风暴对房屋造成了严重损害。
words.en: Damage is physical harm that is caused to something which makes it less attractive, useful, or valuable.

words.ex: The ground is damp after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后地面是潮湿的。
words.en: Something that is damp is slightly wet, often in a way that is unpleasant.

words.tr:
n. 舞蹈；
v. 跳舞；
words.ex: She loves to watch the traditional dance.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢观看传统舞蹈。
words.en: To move your body rhythmically to music, typically following a set sequence of steps.

words.ex: There is danger near the river.
words.ex_cn: 河边有危险。
words.en: Danger is the possibility that someone may be harmed or killed.

words.ex: The river is dangerous for children.
words.ex_cn: 这条河对孩子来说很危险。
words.en: If something is dangerous, it is able or likely to hurt or harm you.

words.ex: He dare not speak up in class.
words.ex_cn: 他不敢在课堂上发言。
words.en: If you dare to do something, you are brave enough to do it, even though it may be dangerous or shocking or may cause trouble for you.

words.tr:
adj. 黑暗的；暗色的；深色的；
n. 黑暗；夜；暗色；
words.ex: The room was dark after the power went out.
words.ex_cn: 停电后，房间变得黑暗。
words.en: The absence of light in a place is referred to as dark. It can also describe something that is not light in color, or something that is mysterious or difficult to understand.

words.ex: The teacher collected data from the students' tests.
words.ex_cn: 老师收集了学生测试的数据。
words.en: Data is information, especially facts or numbers, collected to be examined and considered and used to help decision-making, or information in an electronic form that can be stored and used by a computer.

words.tr:
n. 日期；年代；约会；枣子；枣椰树；
v. 标日期；约会；追溯到；过时；
words.ex: What is the date today?
words.ex_cn: 今天是几号？
words.en: A date is a specific day of the month or year, which can be identified by a particular name or number.

words.ex: My daughter loves to read books.
words.ex_cn: 我的女儿喜欢读书。
words.en: A daughter is a female child in relation to her parents.

words.ex: The birds sing at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在黎明时歌唱。
words.en: The first appearance of light in the sky before sunrise; the beginning of a phenomenon or period of time.

words.ex: I will see you tomorrow day.
words.ex_cn: 我明天见你。
words.en: A day is a period of twenty-four hours, especially from twelve o'clock one night to twelve o'clock the next night.

words.ex: He finished his homework before the deadline.
words.ex_cn: 他在截止日期前完成了作业。
words.en: A deadline is a time or date before which a particular task must be finished or a particular thing must be done.

words.tr:
v. 处理；对付；交易；
n. 交易；协议；
words.ex: He can deal with difficult problems easily.
words.ex_cn: 他能轻松处理困难的问题。
words.en: A deal is an agreement or arrangement, especially in business or politics, that is beneficial to all the parties involved.

words.tr: adj. 亲爱的；昂贵的；宝贵的；
words.ex: Dear friend, I miss you so much.
words.ex_cn: 亲爱的朋友，我非常想念你。
words.en: If someone or something is dear to you, it means you have a lot of affection for them or it is very important to you.

words.ex: His death made everyone very sad.
words.ex_cn: 他的去世让所有人都很难过。
words.en: The end of the life of a person or organism.

words.tr:
n. 辩论；讨论；
v. 辩论；讨论；
words.ex: The students had a debate about homework.
words.ex_cn: 学生们就作业进行了一场辩论。
words.en: If you maintain something, you continue to have it, and do not let it stop or grow weaker.

words.ex: He paid off his debt last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月还清了债务。
words.en: A debt is a sum of money that you owe someone.

words.ex: He lived in Paris for a decade.
words.ex_cn: 他在巴黎生活了十年。
words.en: A decade is a period of ten years, especially one that begins with a year ending in 0, for example 1980 to 1989.

words.tr:
n. 腐烂；衰落；
v. 腐烂；
words.ex: The fruit began to show signs of decay.
words.ex_cn: 这水果开始出现腐烂的迹象。
words.en: To decay means to be slowly destroyed by a natural process or to become gradually worse in quality, condition, or strength.

words.ex: He deceived his friend with a lie.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个谎言欺骗了朋友。
words.en: If you deceive someone, you make them believe something that is not true, usually in order to get some advantage for yourself.

words.ex: My birthday is in December.
words.ex_cn: 我的生日在十二月。
words.en: December is the twelfth and last month of the year in the Julian and Gregorian calendars and the seventh and last of seven months to have a length of 31 days.

words.ex: He decides to go home early.
words.ex_cn: 他决定早点回家。
words.en: If you decide to do something, you choose to do it, usually after you have thought carefully about the other possibilities.

words.ex: The president will declare a holiday next week.
words.ex_cn: 总统将在下周宣布放假。
words.en: If you declare something, you state it formally, publicly, or officially.

words.ex: We decorate the room for the party.
words.ex_cn: 我们为派对装饰房间。
words.en: To make something look more attractive by putting things on it or around it.

words.tr:
n. 减少；
v. 减少；降低；
words.ex: There was a decrease in rainfall last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月降雨量减少了。
words.en: If something decreases or you decrease it, it becomes less in quantity, size, or intensity.

words.ex: He dedicates his time to helping poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他致力于帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: If you dedicate yourself to something, you give all your attention and effort to it.

words.ex: He can deduce the answer from the clues.
words.ex_cn: 他能从线索中推断出答案。
words.en: If you deduce something or deduce that something is true, you reach that conclusion because of other things that you know to be true.

words.ex: He did a good deed for his neighbor.
words.ex_cn: 他为邻居做了一件好事。
words.en: A deed is something that is done, especially something that is very good or very bad. It can also refer to a legal document that is signed and delivered, especially one regarding the ownership of property or legal rights.

words.tr:
adj. 深的；
adv. 深深地；
n. 深处；
words.ex: The well is deep.
words.ex_cn: 这口井很深。
words.en: Extending far down from the top or surface; of great vertical extent.

words.tr:
n. 失败；
v. 击败；战胜；
words.ex: The team accepted the defeat with pride.
words.ex_cn: 球队以自豪的态度接受了失败。
words.en: If you defeat someone, you win a victory over them in a battle, game, or contest.

words.ex: The team improved its defense in the second half.
words.ex_cn: 球队在下半场改进了防守。
words.en: The act of defending against attack, danger, or injury.

words.ex: The teacher define the word 'love' in simple terms.
words.ex_cn: 老师用简单的词给‘爱’下定义。
words.en: If you define something, you show, describe, or state clearly what it is and what its limits are, or what it is like.

words.ex: He gave a definite answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了肯定的答案。
words.en: If something is definite, it is firm and clear, and unlikely to be changed.

words.ex: The temperature is 30 degrees today.
words.ex_cn: 今天气温是30度。
words.en: A degree is a unit of measurement for angles, or a qualification given to a student by a college or university after they have completed a course of study.

words.tr:
n. 推迟；延缓；耽搁；
v. 推迟；延缓；耽搁；
words.ex: The flight had a delay because of the storm.
words.ex_cn: 由于风暴，航班推迟了。
words.en: If you delay doing something, you do not do it immediately or at the planned or expected time, but you leave it until later.

words.ex: He will delete the old file.
words.ex_cn: 他会删除那个旧文件。
words.en: To delete something means to remove it or erase it.

words.tr: adj. 精致的；微妙的；易碎的；脆弱的；
words.ex: She wore a delicate lace dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条精致的蕾丝连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: Something that is delicate is small and beautifully shaped. It can also be easily broken or damaged.

words.ex: The cake tastes delicious.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕味道很美味。
words.en: If you describe food or drink as delicious, you mean that it has a very pleasant taste.

words.ex: The children felt delight when they saw the toys.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们看到玩具时感到高兴。
words.en: Delight is a feeling of very great pleasure.

words.tr: v. 兑现；递送；交付；发表；为…接生；
words.ex: He promised to deliver on his goal.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺要兑现自己的目标。
words.en: To bring and hand over (a letter, parcel, or ordered goods) to the proper recipient or address.

words.tr:
n. 需求；要求；
v. 要求；需求；
words.ex: The demand for clean water is increasing.
words.ex_cn: 对清洁水的需求正在增加。
words.en: If you demand something, you ask for it very forcefully, often because you think you have a right to do so.

words.ex: People vote in democracy to choose their leaders.
words.ex_cn: 人们在民主制度下投票选择他们的领导人。
words.en: A system of government by the whole population or all the eligible members of a state, typically through elected representatives.

words.ex: The experiment demonstrates that water boils at 100°C.
words.ex_cn: 这个实验证明水在100摄氏度时沸腾。
words.en: To demonstrate means to show something clearly by giving proof or evidence.

words.tr: v. 公开指责；告发；揭发
words.ex: He denounces corruption in his speech.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲中谴责腐败。
words.en: If you denounce a person or an action, you criticize them severely and publicly because you feel strongly that they are wrong or evil.

words.ex: The forest is dense with trees.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林树木茂密。
words.en: Something that is dense contains a lot of things or people in a small area.

words.ex: He visits the dentist every six months.
words.ex_cn: 他每六个月去看一次牙医。
words.en: A dentist is a person who is qualified to treat diseases and conditions that affect the teeth and gums, especially the repair and extraction of teeth and the insertion of artificial ones.

words.ex: He denies taking the money.
words.ex_cn: 他否认拿了钱。
words.en: To deny means to declare that something is not true, or to refuse to give or grant something.

words.ex: He will depart tomorrow morning.
words.ex_cn: 他明天早上离开。
words.en: If you depart from a place, you leave it and start a journey to another place.

words.ex: Children depend on their parents for food and shelter.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们依靠父母提供食物和住所。
words.en: If you say that one thing depends on another, you mean that the first thing will be affected or determined by the second.

words.ex: You need to pay a 40-yuan deposit to rent the bike.
words.ex_cn: 租自行车需要支付40元押金。
words.en: A deposit is a sum of money which is part of the full price of something, and which you pay when you agree to buy it. It is also a sum of money that you pay into a bank account.

words.ex: The depth of the river is dangerous.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的深度很危险。
words.en: The distance from the top or surface to the bottom of something.

words.ex: We derive the answer from the formula.
words.ex_cn: 我们从公式中得到答案。
words.en: If you derive something such as pleasure or benefit from a person or from something, you get it from them.

words.ex: The teacher gave a clear description of the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 老师对实验做了清晰的描述。
words.en: A description of someone or something is a statement that explains what they are or what they are like.

words.ex: The camel walks across the desert.
words.ex_cn: 骆驼穿越沙漠。
words.en: A desert is a large area of land that has very little water and very few plants growing on it. Many deserts are covered by sand. If you desert someone or something, you leave them and no longer help or support them.

words.tr:
n. 设计；图案；花样；企图；图谋；
v. 设计；计划；谋划；构思；
words.ex: The dress has a beautiful design.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子有一个美丽的设计。
words.en: To design something means to plan and make a detailed drawing of it, or to plan and create something in a skillful or artistic way.

words.ex: He does his homework at the desk.
words.ex_cn: 他在书桌上做作业。
words.en: A desk is a piece of furniture with a flat surface, typically used for writing, reading, or working on a computer.

words.ex: He ate ice cream for dessert.
words.ex_cn: 他吃冰淇淋当甜食。
words.en: Dessert is a sweet course eaten at the end of a meal.

words.ex: The train's destination is Beijing.
words.ex_cn: 这列火车的目的地是北京。
words.en: The place to which someone or something is going or being sent.

words.ex: The storm destroyed the old bridge.
words.ex_cn: 风暴摧毁了那座旧桥。
words.en: To destroy something means to cause so much damage to it that it is completely ruined or does not exist any more.

words.ex: He noticed every detail of the painting.
words.ex_cn: 他注意到了这幅画的每一个细节。
words.en: A detail is a small individual feature or element of something.

words.ex: I can detect a change in her mood.
words.ex_cn: 我能察觉到她情绪的变化。
words.en: To detect something means to find it or discover it, often using special equipment or methods.

words.ex: The teacher will determine the winner of the contest.
words.ex_cn: 老师将确定比赛的获胜者。
words.en: If you determine something, you decide it or settle it.

words.ex: The country is developing its economy.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在发展它的经济。
words.en: To develop means to grow or cause to grow and become more mature, advanced, or elaborate.

words.ex: He bought a new device to take photos.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一个新设备来拍照。
words.en: A device is an object or machine that has been invented for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The devil made him do it.
words.ex_cn: 魔鬼让他这么做的。
words.en: In Christian theology, the devil is the supreme spirit of evil, often represented as the tempter of humankind and the enemy of God and goodness.

words.ex: The teacher drew a diagram to explain the water cycle.
words.ex_cn: 老师画了一个图表来解释水循环。
words.en: A diagram is a simple drawing which consists mainly of lines and is used, for example, to explain how a machine works.

words.tr:
n. 刻度盘；
v. 拨；
words.ex: He looked at the clock's dial to check the time.
words.ex_cn: 他看着钟的刻度盘来查看时间。
words.en: A dial is the face of a clock or watch, or a similar control on a piece of equipment, which shows you the time or other information. As a verb, to dial means to call a telephone number by pressing the buttons on a telephone.

words.ex: She wore a diamond ring on her finger.
words.ex_cn: 她手指上戴着一枚钻石戒指。
words.en: A diamond is a precious stone consisting of a clear and colorless crystalline form of pure carbon, the hardest naturally occurring substance.

words.ex: He writes in his diary every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都写日记。
words.en: A diary is a book in which you write down your personal experiences and thoughts each day.

words.tr:
n. 日常饮食；节食；
v. 节制饮食；
words.ex: His diet includes lots of vegetables and fruits.
words.ex_cn: 他的日常饮食包括大量蔬菜和水果。
words.en: The food and drink usually consumed by a person or group; a special course of food to which one restricts oneself, either to lose weight or for medical reasons.

words.ex: This color differs from that one.
words.ex_cn: 这个颜色和那个不同。
words.en: If two or more things differ, they are unlike each other in some way.

words.ex: There is a big difference between apples and oranges.
words.ex_cn: 苹果和橙子之间有很大的差异。
words.en: A difference is a way in which two or more things are not the same.

words.ex: This math problem is difficult.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学题很难。
words.en: Something that is difficult is not easy to do, understand, or deal with.

words.ex: The stomach digests food into nutrients.
words.ex_cn: 胃将食物消化成营养物质。
words.en: To digest means to break down food in the stomach and intestines into substances that can be absorbed by the body. It can also mean to understand or assimilate information. As a noun, it refers to a compilation or summary of information.

words.ex: He uses a digital watch to tell time.
words.ex_cn: 他用一块数字手表看时间。
words.en: Digital systems, devices, or technology use electronic signals that are represented by the numbers 1 and 0, indicating 'on' or 'off'.

words.ex: He kept his dignity even when he was poor.
words.ex_cn: 即使他很穷，他依然保持尊严。
words.en: Dignity is the quality of being worthy of honor or respect.

words.ex: We have dinner at 7 p.m. every day.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天晚上7点吃晚餐。
words.en: The main meal of the day, eaten in the evening or at midday.

words.tr:
adj. 直接的；
v. 指导；指示；
words.ex: He gave a direct answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对问题给出了直接的答案。
words.en: If you direct something at a particular thing, you aim or point it at that thing.

words.ex: He asked for the direction to the station.
words.ex_cn: 他问了去车站的方向。
words.en: A direction is the way that you have to travel to get from one place to another, or the way that something is moving or pointing.

words.ex: The director of the school gave a speech.
words.ex_cn: 学校的主任发表了一次演讲。
words.en: A director is a person who is in charge of something, especially a film, play, or organization.

words.ex: He washed his hands to remove the dirt.
words.ex_cn: 他洗手以去除污垢。
words.en: Dirt is any substance that makes something unclean, such as mud or dust.

words.ex: The accident disabled him for life.
words.ex_cn: 这场事故使他终身残废。
words.en: If an injury or illness disables someone, it affects them so badly that it restricts the way that they can live their life.

words.ex: The disadvantage of living far away is long commute time.
words.ex_cn: 住得远的劣势是通勤时间长。
words.en: A disadvantage is a factor which makes someone or something less useful, acceptable, or successful than other people or things.

words.ex: He discovered a new planet last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年发现了一颗新行星。
words.en: If you discover something that you did not know about before, you become aware of it or find it.

words.ex: We had a discussion about homework.
words.ex_cn: 我们进行了一次关于作业的讨论。
words.en: A discussion is a conversation or debate about a specific topic.

words.ex: The doctor treated his disease with medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生用药物治疗了他的疾病。
words.en: A disease is an illness that affects people, animals, or plants, often caused by infection or a failure of health rather than by an accident.

words.ex: He put the food on a clean dish.
words.ex_cn: 他把食物放在一个干净的盘子里。
words.en: A dish is a shallow container used for cooking or serving food.

words.ex: He dismissed her advice and walked away.
words.ex_cn: 他不理会她的建议，走开了。
words.en: If you dismiss someone, you send them away or allow them to leave.

words.ex: The room was in complete disorder.
words.ex_cn: 房间一片混乱。
words.en: A disorder is a state of confusion or untidiness, or a medical problem that affects the mind or body.

words.tr:
n. 展示；陈列；
v. 展示；陈列；
words.ex: The store has a big display of new phones.
words.ex_cn: 商店里有一个新手机的展示。
words.en: To display something means to put it in a place where people can see it easily, or to show it to people.

words.ex: The distance between the two towns is 10 kilometers.
words.ex_cn: 两个城镇之间的距离是10公里。
words.en: The amount of space between two places or things.

words.ex: The mountains look distant from here.
words.ex_cn: 从这里看，山显得很远。
words.en: If you describe something as distant, you mean that it is far away in space or time.

words.ex: The two colors are distinct.
words.ex_cn: 这两种颜色有区别。
words.en: If something is distinct, it is easily seen, heard, or understood.

words.ex: The two colors distinguish the two teams.
words.ex_cn: 这两种颜色使两个队伍有所不同。
words.en: If you can distinguish one thing from another, you can see or understand how they are different.

words.ex: He felt great distress when he lost his job.
words.ex_cn: 当他失去工作时，他感到非常忧虑。
words.en: Distress is a feeling of extreme worry, sadness, or pain.

words.ex: The teacher will distribute the books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将把书分发给学生。
words.en: If you distribute things, you hand them or deliver them to a number of people.

words.ex: This district has many parks and schools.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区有许多公园和学校。
words.en: A district is a part of a city, country, or other area that has been officially designated for a particular purpose, such as administration or business.

words.ex: Please don't disturb me while I'm reading.
words.ex_cn: 我读书时请不要打扰我。
words.en: To disturb someone means to interrupt what they are doing and cause them inconvenience or annoyance.

words.tr: adj. 不同的；多种多样的；
words.ex: The class has diverse students from many countries.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级有来自许多国家的不同学生。
words.en: If a group or range of things is diverse, it is made up of a wide variety of things.

words.ex: She will divide the cake into two parts.
words.ex_cn: 她将把蛋糕分成两部分。
words.en: If you divide something, you separate it into two or more parts.

words.tr:
n. 离婚；
v. 和…离婚；
words.ex: They filed for divorce after ten years of marriage.
words.ex_cn: 他们结婚十年后申请了离婚。
words.en: Divorce is the formal ending of a marriage by law.

words.ex: I do my homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我每天晚上做作业。
words.en: To perform or accomplish something

words.ex: The doctor helped the sick child.
words.ex_cn: 医生帮助了生病的孩子。
words.en: A doctor is someone who is qualified in medicine and treats people who are ill.

words.tr:
n. 文件；公文；文献；
v. 记录；为…提供证明；
words.ex: He submitted the document to the office.
words.ex_cn: 他把文件提交给了办公室。
words.en: A document is a piece of text or graphics, for example a letter, that is stored as a file on a computer and that you can access in order to read it or change it.

words.ex: The dog barks loudly at night.
words.ex_cn: 狗在晚上大声吠叫。
words.en: A dog is a very common four-legged animal that is often kept by people as a pet or to guard or hunt.

words.ex: The little girl plays with a doll.
words.ex_cn: 小女孩在玩一个洋娃娃。
words.en: A doll is a child's toy which looks like a small person or baby.

words.ex: He is an expert in the domain of artificial intelligence.
words.ex_cn: 他是人工智能领域的专家。
words.en: A domain is a particular field of thought, activity, or interest, especially one over which someone has control, influence, or rights.

words.tr: adj. 家庭的；国内的；驯养的；
words.ex: She prefers domestic chores over going out.
words.ex_cn: 她更喜欢做家务而不是外出。
words.en: Domestic means relating to the home, family, or household affairs. It can also refer to something that is made or produced within a country and not imported.

words.ex: The dominant color in the room is blue.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间占优势的颜色是蓝色。
words.en: Someone or something that is dominant is more powerful, successful, influential, or noticeable than other people or things.

words.ex: He donate money to the poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他向贫困儿童捐赠钱。
words.en: To donate means to give something, especially money, to a person or organization that needs help.

words.ex: He closed the door quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他轻轻地关上了门。
words.en: A door is a piece of wood, glass, or metal, which is moved to open and close the entrance to a building, room, cupboard, or vehicle.

words.ex: He lives in the dormitory with three roommates.
words.ex_cn: 他和三个室友住在宿舍里。
words.en: A dormitory is a large bedroom where many people sleep, especially in a school or college.

words.ex: The doctor gave him a small dose of medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生给了他一小剂量的药。
words.en: A dose of a medicine or a drug is the amount of it that you take at one time, or the amount that is recommended for you to take.

words.tr:
n. 两倍；
v. 加倍；是…的两倍；把…对折；
words.ex: He earned a double of his salary last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月赚了两倍的薪水。
words.en: If something is double, it is twice as much or twice as many. If you double something, you make it twice as much or twice as many.

words.tr:
n. 疑问；疑惑；
v. 怀疑；拿不准；
words.ex: I have doubt about the answer.
words.ex_cn: 我对这个答案有疑问。
words.en: If you have doubt or doubts about something, you feel uncertain about it and do not know whether it is true or possible. If you say that something is beyond doubt, you mean that it is definitely true.

words.tr:
adv. 向下；
prep. 沿…向下；
adj. 向下的；沮丧的；
words.ex: The ball fell down.
words.ex_cn: 球掉了下去。
words.en: Down is used to indicate movement from a higher to a lower position. It can also refer to a state of being less active or successful.

words.ex: I bought a dozen eggs from the store.
words.ex_cn: 我从商店买了十二个鸡蛋。
words.en: If you have a dozen things, you have twelve of them.

words.ex: He wrote a draft of the letter before sending it.
words.ex_cn: 他在发送之前写了这封信的草稿。
words.en: A draft is a preliminary version of a piece of writing, or a current of air in a room or other confined space. It can also refer to the act of selecting someone for a particular purpose or task, especially in sports or the military.

words.ex: He drag the box across the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他把箱子拖过地板。
words.en: To pull something along the ground, often with difficulty or effort.

words.ex: The boy drew a big dragon on his notebook.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在他的笔记本上画了一条大龙。
words.en: A mythical monster like a giant reptile. In European tradition, it is typically fire-breathing and tends to symbolize chaos or evil, whereas in East Asia it is usually a beneficent symbol of fertility, associated with water and the heavens.

words.ex: He loves watching drama on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在电视上看戏剧。
words.en: A drama is a serious play for the theatre, television, or radio, or a serious style of acting intended to represent real life and characters.

words.tr: adj. 急剧的；引人注目的；戏剧（性）的；
words.ex: There was a dramatic increase in temperature yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天温度急剧上升。
words.en: If something is dramatic, it happens or changes suddenly and noticeably.

words.ex: I draw money from the bank every week.
words.ex_cn: 我每周从银行提取钱。
words.en: To make a picture, pattern, or diagram by making lines and marks, especially with a pen or pencil, on paper.

words.tr:
n. 梦；梦想；
v. 梦想；做梦；
words.ex: I had a strange dream last night.
words.ex_cn: 我昨晚做了一个奇怪的梦。
words.en: A dream is a series of thoughts, images, and sensations occurring in a person's mind during sleep. It can also refer to a cherished aspiration, ambition, or ideal.

words.tr:
n. 连衣裙；衣服；
v. 穿衣服；
words.ex: She wore a red dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条红色连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: A dress is a piece of clothing for women or girls that covers the body and part or all of the legs. To dress means to put clothes on yourself or someone else.

words.tr:
n. 饮料；酒；
v. 喝；喝酒；
words.ex: I bought a cold drink at the store.
words.ex_cn: 我在商店买了一瓶冷饮。
words.en: To take liquid into the mouth and swallow it; a liquid that can be swallowed as refreshment or nourishment.

words.tr:
v. 驾驶；驱使；
n. 动力；
words.ex: He drives a car to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天开车去上班。
words.en: To operate and control the direction and speed of a motor vehicle; to push, propel, or carry along forcibly or strongly.

words.ex: The driver stopped the car at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 司机在红灯处停了车。
words.en: A driver is a person who drives a vehicle.

words.tr:
v. 落下；掉下；
n. 滴；下落；
words.ex: The apple dropped from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 苹果从树上落了下来。
words.en: If you drop something, you accidentally let it fall.

words.ex: The drought made it hard to grow crops.
words.ex_cn: 旱灾使种植庄稼变得困难。
words.en: A drought is a long period of time during which no rain falls and hence there is a shortage of water.

words.ex: The heavy rain drowned the small village.
words.ex_cn: 大雨淹没了这个小村庄。
words.en: To die by being underwater too long and unable to breathe, or to kill someone in this way.

words.ex: The doctor prescribed a drug for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他开了一种治疗头痛的药物。
words.en: A drug is a substance which is used to treat an illness, relieve a symptom, or modify a chemical process in the body for a specific purpose.

words.ex: He plays the drum in a band.
words.ex_cn: 他在乐队里打鼓。
words.en: A drum is a musical instrument consisting of a skin stretched tightly over a round frame. You play it by hitting it with sticks or with your hands.

words.tr:
adj. 干的；
v. 变干；
words.ex: The cloth is dry after the sun.
words.ex_cn: 这块布在阳光下晒干了。
words.en: If something is dry, there is no water or moisture on it or in it.

words.ex: The duck swims in the pond.
words.ex_cn: 鸭子在池塘里游泳。
words.en: A duck is a bird that lives by water and has webbed feet, a short neck, and a large flat beak. As a verb, to duck means to lower the head or body quickly to avoid being hit or seen.

words.tr: adj. 阴暗的；枯燥的；无趣的；
words.ex: The room was dull because the windows were covered.
words.ex_cn: 房间很阴暗，因为窗户被遮住了。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as dull, you mean they are not interesting or exciting.

words.ex: He gave a dumb answer to the simple question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个简单的问题给出了一个愚笨的回答。
words.en: If someone is dumb, they are unable to speak. If you describe someone or something as dumb, you mean that they are stupid or silly.

words.ex: He dumped the trash into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把垃圾倒进了垃圾桶。
words.en: To dump something means to get rid of it quickly and without care, often because it is no longer wanted or needed. It can also refer to the place where waste is left.

words.ex: He slept during the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他在看电影时睡着了。
words.en: Throughout the course or duration of (a period of time).

words.ex: The worker wore a mask to avoid breathing in dust.
words.ex_cn: 这位工人戴上口罩以避免吸入粉尘。
words.en: Dust is a layer of fine, dry particles on the surface of something, or the fine, dry particles themselves.

words.ex: It is your duty to finish your homework.
words.ex_cn: 完成你的作业是你的职责。
words.en: A duty is a task or action that someone is required to perform.

words.tr:
adj. 动态的；有活力的；不断变化的；
n. 活力；动力；
words.ex: The game has dynamic weather that changes every hour.
words.ex_cn: 这个游戏有每小时变化的动态天气。
words.en: If you describe someone as dynamic, you approve of them because they are full of energy or full of new ideas.

words.tr:
adj. 每个的；各自的；
pron. 每个；各自；
words.ex: Each student has a book.
words.ex_cn: 每个学生都有一本书。
words.en: Used to refer to every one of a group or series considered individually.

words.ex: The children are eager to open their presents.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们渴望打开他们的礼物。
words.en: If you are eager to do or have something, you want to do or have it very much.

words.ex: He hurt his ear while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了耳朵。
words.en: The organ of hearing in humans and other vertebrates, especially the external part of this organ.

words.tr:
adj. 早的；早前的；
adv. 提早地；
words.ex: He woke up early this morning.
words.ex_cn: 他今天早上起得很早。
words.en: Before the usual or expected time; at or near the beginning of a particular period or series of events.

words.ex: He works hard to earn money.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以赚取收入。
words.en: To earn means to gain something, especially money or respect, through your own efforts or work.

words.ex: The earth goes around the sun.
words.ex_cn: 地球围绕太阳运转。
words.en: The planet on which we live; the land surface of the world as distinct from the sea or the air.

words.tr:
n. 安逸；轻松；
v. 缓解；减轻；
words.ex: He enjoys the ease of living in a quiet village.
words.ex_cn: 他享受住在安静村庄里的安逸。
words.en: If you talk about the ease of a particular activity, you are referring to the way that it has been made easier to do, or to the fact that it is already easy to do. Ease is also a state of being comfortable and without worry or anxiety.

words.tr:
n. 东方；
adj. 东方的；
adv. 在东方；
words.ex: The sun rises in the east.
words.ex_cn: 太阳从东方升起。
words.en: The direction towards the point of the horizon where the sun rises at the equinoxes, on the right-hand side of a person facing north.

words.ex: This math problem is easy.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学题很容易。
words.en: If a job or action is easy, you can do it without difficulty because it is not complicated and causes no problems.

words.tr:
n. 回声；
v. 回响；
words.ex: The echo came back from the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 回声从山上反弹回来。
words.en: An echo is a sound which is caused by a noise being reflected off a surface such as a wall.

words.ex: The economic situation is getting worse.
words.ex_cn: 经济状况正在恶化。
words.en: Economic means concerned with the organization of the money, industry, and trade of a country, region, or society.

words.ex: The country's economy is growing fast.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的经济正在快速增长。
words.en: The economy of a country or region is the system by which money, industry, and trade are organized.

words.ex: The edge of the table is sharp.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的边缘很锋利。
words.en: The edge of something is the place or line where it stops, or the part of it that is furthest from the middle.

words.ex: He edits the school newspaper every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周编辑校报。
words.en: To prepare written material for publication by correcting, condensing, or otherwise modifying it.

words.ex: They want to educate their children well.
words.ex_cn: 他们想好好教育自己的孩子。
words.en: To educate someone means to teach them over a period of time at a school, college, or university.

words.tr: n. 影响；作用；效果；效应；
words.ex: The new law had a big effect on traffic.
words.ex_cn: 新法律对交通产生了很大影响。
words.en: A change that is a result or consequence of an action or other cause.

words.ex: He uses an efficient way to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用一种高效的方法解决数学问题。
words.en: If something or someone is efficient, they are able to do tasks successfully, without wasting time or energy.

words.ex: He made a big effort to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他努力完成这个项目，按时交工。
words.en: If you make an effort to do something, you try hard to do it.

words.ex: She boiled an egg for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 她为早餐煮了一个蛋。
words.en: An egg is an oval object that is produced by a female bird and which contains a baby bird. Other animals such as reptiles and fish also lay eggs.

words.ex: He has eight apples in his bag.
words.ex_cn: 他包里有八个苹果。
words.en: The number equivalent to the product of two and four; one more than seven, or two less than ten; 8.

words.ex: The rubber band is elastic.
words.ex_cn: 橡皮筋是有弹性的。
words.en: An elastic material is able to stretch and then return to its original shape or size.

words.tr:
n. 肘部
v. 用肘推挤
words.ex: He hurt his elbow while playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他在打篮球时伤了肘部。
words.en: The joint between the forearm and the upper arm; to push someone with your elbow.

words.tr:
adj. 年长的；
n. 长者；
words.ex: My elder brother works as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 我年长的哥哥是一名老师。
words.en: An elder is a person who is older than you, especially one who is respected for their wisdom and experience.

words.ex: The electric lamp lights up the room.
words.ex_cn: 电灯照亮了房间。
words.en: Something that is electric works by means of electricity, is powered by electricity, or produces electricity.

words.ex: He fixed the electrical wire with tape.
words.ex_cn: 他用胶带修好了电线。
words.en: Relating to electricity or things that use electricity.

words.ex: The town lost electricity during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴期间，这个城镇停电了。
words.en: A form of energy resulting from the existence of charged particles (such as electrons or protons), either statically as an accumulation of charge or dynamically as a current.

words.ex: The electron moves around the nucleus.
words.ex_cn: 电子围绕原子核运动。
words.en: An electron is a tiny particle with a negative charge that is found in all atoms and plays a key role in electricity.

words.ex: Water is made of two elements: hydrogen and oxygen.
words.ex_cn: 水由两种要素组成：氢和氧。
words.en: An element is a substance that cannot be separated into simpler substances by chemical means and is composed of atoms having the same number of protons.

words.ex: The elephant walks slowly in the zoo.
words.ex_cn: 大象在动物园里慢慢走。
words.en: An elephant is a very large animal with a long trunk, large ears, and two long curved tusks. Elephants are found in Africa and Asia.

words.ex: He took the elevator to the 10th floor.
words.ex_cn: 他乘电梯上了十楼。
words.en: An elevator is a device that moves people or goods up and down inside a building.

words.ex: We must eliminate the waste to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 我们必须消除浪费以保护环境。
words.en: To eliminate something, especially something you do not want or need, means to remove it completely.

words.tr:
adv. 另外；其他；
adj. 别的；其他的；
words.ex: I want tea, else coffee.
words.ex_cn: 我想喝茶，另外也想喝咖啡。
words.en: In addition to what has already been mentioned or considered.

words.tr:
adj. 空的；无意义的；
v. 倒空；
words.ex: The box is empty.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子是空的。
words.en: If you describe a place, object, or person as empty, you mean that they contain nothing or have no special qualities, and are therefore not interesting or useful.

words.ex: The new tool enables him to finish work faster.
words.ex_cn: 这个新工具使他能够更快地完成工作。
words.en: If someone or something enables you to do a particular thing, they give you the opportunity or means to do it.

words.tr:
v. 遭遇；遇到；邂逅；
n. 遭遇；
words.ex: He encountered a bear while hiking in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他在森林里徒步时遭遇了一只熊。
words.en: If you encounter problems or difficulties, you experience them.

words.ex: My teacher encourages me to speak English every day.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师鼓励我每天说英语。
words.en: If you encourage someone, you give them confidence, for example by letting them know that what they are doing is good and telling them that they should continue to do it.

words.tr: n. 结束；结局； v. 结束；“end”的现在分词；
words.ex: The ending of the movie was surprising.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的结束令人惊讶。
words.en: The final part of something, especially a story, movie, or play.

words.ex: He had to endure the cold winter without a coat.
words.ex_cn: 他不得不在没有外套的情况下忍受寒冷的冬天。
words.en: To endure means to suffer something difficult, unpleasant, or painful, or to continue to exist for a long time.

words.ex: China uses a lot of energy from coal.
words.ex_cn: 中国使用大量煤炭能源。
words.en: Energy is the ability and strength to do active physical things and the feeling that you are full of physical power and life.

words.ex: The police enforce the law.
words.ex_cn: 警察强制执行法律。
words.en: If people in authority enforce a law or a rule, they make sure that it is obeyed, usually by punishing people who do not obey it.

words.tr: v. 参与；从事；吸引；与…建立密切关系；
words.ex: He engages in community volunteer work.
words.ex_cn: 他参与社区志愿工作。
words.en: To engage means to occupy, attract, or involve someone or oneself in a particular activity or situation.

words.ex: The car has a strong engine.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有一个强劲的发动机。
words.en: An engine is a machine that converts energy into mechanical force and motion.

words.ex: He is an engineer who builds bridges.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名建造桥梁的工程师。
words.en: An engineer is a person who designs, builds, or maintains engines, machines, or public works.

words.tr:
n. 英语；英文；
adj. 英格兰的；英格兰人的；英语的；
words.ex: He speaks English every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天说英语。
words.en: English refers to the language spoken in Britain, the United States, and many other parts of the world, as well as to the people of England.

words.ex: I enjoy eating ice cream on hot days.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢在热天吃冰淇淋。
words.en: If you enjoy something, you find pleasure and satisfaction in doing it or experiencing it.

words.ex: The company plans to enlarge its office space.
words.ex_cn: 公司计划扩大其办公空间。
words.en: To make something bigger or more extensive.

words.tr:
adv. 足够地；充分地；
adj. 足够的；充足的；
int. 够了；
words.ex: He didn't run fast enough to win the race.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得不够快，没能赢得比赛。
words.en: as much or as many as required.

words.ex: He enters the room quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他悄悄地进入房间。
words.en: To come or go into a place; to become involved in a situation or activity; to begin a particular period or stage; to record information in a book or computer.

words.ex: Watching movies is a popular entertainment.
words.ex_cn: 看电影是一种流行的休闲娱乐。
words.en: Entertainment refers to performances or activities that are intended to amuse or interest an audience.

words.tr: adj. 全部的；整个的；完全的；
words.ex: He ate the entire cake.
words.ex_cn: 他吃掉了整个蛋糕。
words.en: You use entire to emphasize that you are referring to the whole of something, for example, the whole of a place, time, or population.

words.ex: The entrance to the building is on the left.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑的入口在左边。
words.en: An entrance is a way into a place, such as a door or gate. It can also refer to the act of entering a place or the right to enter.

words.tr: n. 进入；入口；条目；参与；参赛作品；
words.ex: The entry to the building is locked after 10 PM.
words.ex_cn: 建筑物在晚上10点后进入通道会被锁上。
words.en: An entry is the act of going into a place or the right to go into it. It can also refer to a door, gate, or passage by which you enter a place. Additionally, an entry can be a piece of information recorded in a book, list, or computer, or the act of recording it.

words.ex: He put the letter in an envelope.
words.ex_cn: 他把信装进了一个信封。
words.en: An envelope is a flat, usually rectangular or square, paper container for a letter, which you seal before you send it by post.

words.ex: He protects the environment by recycling.
words.ex_cn: 他通过回收利用来保护环境。
words.en: The environment is the natural world in which people, animals, and plants live.

words.tr:
adj. 相等的；同等的；
v. 等于；比得上；
words.ex: Two plus two is equal to four.
words.ex_cn: 二加二等于四。
words.en: If two things are equal, or if one thing is equal to another, they are the same in size, number, standard, or value.

words.ex: The equator divides the Earth into two halves.
words.ex_cn: 赤道将地球分为两半。
words.en: The equator is an imaginary line around the Earth, equally distant from the North Pole and the South Pole, dividing the Earth into the Northern Hemisphere and the Southern Hemisphere.

words.ex: The gym has new exercise equipment.
words.ex_cn: 健身房有新的健身设备。
words.en: The necessary items for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He erased the wrong answer with an eraser.
words.ex_cn: 他用橡皮擦掉了错误的答案。
words.en: To erase something means to remove it completely from a surface or from a place where it is stored.

words.tr: v. 侵蚀；腐蚀；逐渐丧失；削弱
words.ex: The wind erodes the sand slowly.
words.ex_cn: 风慢慢侵蚀着沙子。
words.en: If rock or soil erodes or is eroded by the weather, sea, or wind, it cracks and breaks so that it is gradually destroyed.

words.ex: He made an error in his math homework.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学作业中犯了一个错误。
words.en: An error is a mistake.

words.tr:
v. 逃避；逃走；
n. 逃脱；逃避；
words.ex: He tried to escape from the prison.
words.ex_cn: 他试图逃离监狱。
words.en: To escape means to get away from a place or a situation that you are in, especially because it is difficult or dangerous to stay there.

words.ex: I like all fruits, especially apples.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢所有的水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: You use especially to emphasize that what you are saying applies more to one thing or situation than to others.

words.ex: He wrote an essay about his summer trip.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于他暑假旅行的文章。
words.en: An essay is a short piece of writing on a particular subject.

words.tr: adj. 必需的；基本的；本质的；
words.ex: Water is essential for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命是必需的。
words.en: Something that is essential is extremely important or absolutely necessary to a particular subject, situation, or activity.

words.ex: They established a new school in the village.
words.ex_cn: 他们在村里建立了一所新学校。
words.en: To set up or create something, such as an organization or a system, on a firm or permanent basis.

words.ex: The old estate has large gardens and a beautiful mansion.
words.ex_cn: 这个古老的庄园有大片花园和一座美丽的豪宅。
words.en: An estate is all the money and property that someone owns, especially everything that is left when they die.

words.tr:
v. 估算；估价；
n. 估价；估算；
words.ex: Can you estimate how long it will take?
words.ex_cn: 你能估算一下需要多长时间吗？
words.en: If you estimate a quantity or value, you make an approximate judgment or calculation of it.

words.ex: The shopkeeper will evaluate the old watch.
words.ex_cn: 店主将估价这块旧手表。
words.en: If you evaluate something or someone, you consider them in order to make a judgment about them, for example about how good or bad they are.

words.tr: n. 事件；大事；比赛项目；
words.ex: The school event was fun for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 学校的活动对每个人都很有趣。
words.en: An event is something that happens, especially when it is unusual or important.

words.ex: He waited for hours, and eventually got his turn.
words.ex_cn: 他等了几个小时，终于轮到他了。
words.en: At an unspecified later time; in the end.

words.tr: adv. 曾经；在任何时候；总是；
words.ex: Have you ever been to Paris?
words.ex_cn: 你曾经去过巴黎吗？
words.en: At any time; always; in any case; used for emphasis when you are comparing things.

words.ex: He eats apples every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃苹果。
words.en: Each and all of the members of a group or set without exception.

words.ex: The police found evidence at the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察在犯罪现场找到了证据。
words.en: Evidence is anything that you see, experience, read, or are told that causes you to believe that something is true or has really happened.

words.tr:
adj. 恶毒的；
n. 邪恶；罪恶；
words.ex: The evil king punished innocent people.
words.ex_cn: 这个恶毒的国王惩罚了无辜的人。
words.en: Evil is a powerful force that some people believe to exist, and which causes wicked and bad things to happen.

words.ex: The evolution of birds from dinosaurs took millions of years.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类从恐龙进化而来花了数百万年。
words.en: The gradual development of something, especially from a simple to a more complex form.

words.ex: The bird evolved from a small dinosaur.
words.ex_cn: 这种鸟由一种小型恐龙演变而来。
words.en: If something evolves or you evolve it, it gradually develops over a period of time into something different and usually more advanced.

words.ex: He gave the exact time of the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他给出了会议的确切时间。
words.en: If you describe something as exact, you mean that it is precise and accurate in all its details.

words.ex: The police will examine the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察将调查犯罪现场。
words.en: If you examine something, you look at it carefully.

words.ex: This is a good example of teamwork.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个团队合作的好例子。
words.en: An example is a particular instance of something that is representative of a group or used to illustrate a point.

words.ex: The car exceeded the speed limit.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车超过了限速。
words.en: To be greater in quantity, degree, or intensity than something else.

words.tr: adj. 优秀的；杰出的；卓越的；
words.ex: He got an excellent score on the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中取得了优异的成绩。
words.en: Something that is excellent is very good indeed.

words.ex: Everyone passed the test, with one exception.
words.ex_cn: 所有人都通过了考试，只有一个例外。
words.en: An exception is a person or thing that is excluded from a general statement or does not follow a rule.

words.tr:
